timeline.description: Safari 浏览器展示 ChatGPT 欢迎页，左侧为深色对话栏；右下角画中画内，一名短发、穿黑色上衣的男子面对镜头讲解，身后可见花束与室内暖光。
男讲解者抬手向观众挥手致意，随后放下手臂继续讲述。
Andrej Karpathy 开场介绍 ChatGPT，称其允许用户与 AI 交互并交付基于文本的任务。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Hi everyone. So by now you have probably heard of ChatGPT. It has taken the world and the AI community by storm, and it is a system that allows you to interact with an AI and give it text-based tasks.

timeline.description: ChatGPT 欢迎页中央显示产品名及三栏功能介绍，左侧栏可见“New chat”和已有对话“AI's Power Prosperity”。
timeline.text:
ChatGPT
Examples
Capabilities
Limitations
New chat
AI's Power Prosperity

timeline.description: 讲解者以生成俳句为例，说明可以向 ChatGPT 下达具体的文本创作要求。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So for example, we can ask ChatGPT to write us a small haiku about how important it is that people understand AI, and that they can use it to improve the world and make it more prosperous.

timeline.description: 男讲解者在底部输入框中放入俳句提示词并提交，页面从欢迎示例切换为包含用户消息的对话视图。
输入框及随后提交的用户消息中显示完整的俳句创作提示词。
timeline.text: Write a small haiku about how important it is that people understand AI, and that they can use it to improve the world and make it more prosperous.

timeline.description: 提交提示词后，讲解者读出逐渐生成的三行俳句，并用“Okay, not bad”评价结果。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So when we run this, AI knowledge brings prosperity for all to see, embrace its power. Okay, not bad.

timeline.description: ChatGPT 从左到右逐词输出三行俳句，生成过程中显示“Stop generating”，完成后变为“Regenerate response”。
第一条对话下方完整显示本次生成的三行俳句。
timeline.text:
AI knowledge brings
Prosperity for all to see
Embrace its power

timeline.description: 男讲解者注视生成结果，随后微笑并短暂大笑，表现出轻松愉快的反应。
讲解者指出，ChatGPT 是按顺序从左到右逐个生成这些词语的。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: And so you could see that ChatGPT went from left to right and generated all these words sort of sequentially.

timeline.description: 讲解者说明自己稍早前使用过完全相同的提示词，但得到了另一版俳句；他读出旧结果，并评价两次输出都不错但略有不同。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Now, I asked it already the exact same prompt a little bit earlier, and it generated a slightly different outcome. AI's power to grow. Ignorance holds us back. Learn. Prosperity waits. So pretty good in both cases and slightly different.

timeline.description: 男讲解者点击左侧的“AI's Power Prosperity”旧对话，切换到此前生成的另一版俳句，与刚才的结果进行对照。
旧对话中显示相同提示词及另一版三行俳句，供观众比较两次生成的差异。
timeline.text:
AI's power to grow
Ignorance holds us back, learn
Prosperity waits

timeline.description: 比较两次输出后，讲解者总结 ChatGPT 是概率性系统，同一个提示词可以得到多个不同回答，并引出这只是人们构想出的众多提示词之一。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So you can see that ChatGPT is a probabilistic system, and for any one prompt, it can give us multiple answers, sort of replying to it. Now, this is just one example of a prompt people have come up with.

timeline.description: Safari 浏览器停在 ChatGPT 的“AI's Power Prosperity”对话页，页面显示一首关于理解 AI、用 AI 促进繁荣的三行俳句。光标移向浏览器上方的 LearnGPT 标签页；右下角可见一名穿黑色上衣的男子面对镜头讲解并做手势。
浏览器切换到 learngpt.com，页面以紫色顶部栏展示“LearnGPT”及 Hot、Newest、Best 分类，主体是带编号和投票箭头的 ChatGPT 提示词示例列表。右下角男子继续面向镜头，伴随讲解做出多种手势。
LearnGPT 列表页展示网站定位及多条幽默提示词，其中包括让 ChatGPT 用对狗解释 HTML、为 Chess 2 写发布说明，以及为 Elon Musk 收购 Twitter 写颂歌。

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Many, many examples, and there are entire websites that index interactions with ChatGPT, and so many of them are quite humorous. "Explain HTML to me like I'm a dog." "Write release notes for Chess 2." "Write an ode about Elon Musk buying Twitter," and so on.

timeline.description: 光标在 LearnGPT 列表中上下移动，依次停留在“Explain HTML to me like I'm a dog”“Write release notes for Chess 2”和“Write an ode about Elon Musk buying Twitter”等条目附近。右下角男子时而微笑，并用手势配合列举。
页面转为 LearnGPT 的单条示例详情，标题是“Please write a breaking news article about a leaf falling from a tree.”，下方分别给出 Human 提示词和 ChatGPT 生成的夸张新闻全文，并提供 Copy Prompt、Open ChatGPT 按钮及 Reddit 来源链接。
详情页显示把树叶从树上落下写成突发新闻的提示词，以及 ChatGPT 生成的新闻标题“Breaking News: Leaf Falls from Tree.”。
timeline.text:
Please write a breaking news article about a leaf falling from a tree.
Copy Prompt / Open ChatGPT
Human: Please write a breaking news article about a leaf falling from a tree.
ChatGPT: Breaking News: Leaf Falls from Tree.

timeline.description: Andrej Karpathy 选取树叶落下的提示词作为具体示例；ASR 中识别异常的片段依据页面标题校正为“breaking news article”。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So as an example: "Please write a breaking news article about a leaf falling from a tree."

timeline.description: Andrej Karpathy 读出 ChatGPT 生成的新闻开头，内容把一片叶子自然落地描述成令人震惊的事件，并引用目击者说法。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: In a shocking turn of events, a leaf has fallen from a tree in a local park. Witnesses report that the leaf, which was previously attached to a branch on the tree, detached itself and fell to the ground.

timeline.description: 阅读这篇刻意夸张的“突发新闻”时，右下角男子多次微笑、张口笑，并抬手比划；光标在生成文本间移动，部分句子短暂被蓝色选中。
Andrej Karpathy 由示例的戏剧性效果转入原理，称该系统为语言模型，说明它建模词、字符或更一般的 token 序列，以及英语中词语如何彼此衔接。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Very dramatic. So you can see that this is a pretty remarkable system, and it is what we call a language model because it models the sequence of words or characters or tokens more generally, and it knows how words follow each other in English language. And so from its perspective,

timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: in 2017, a landmark paper, a landmark paper in AI that produced and proposed the transformer architecture. So GPT is short for generatively pre-trained transformer. So transformer is the neural net that actually does all the heavy lifting under the hood

timeline.description: 讲解者认为这篇论文表面上像普通的机器翻译研究，作者当时或许未充分预见 Transformer 的影响，而该架构后来扩展到了更广泛的 AI 领域。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: It comes from this paper in 2017. Now, if you read this paper, this reads like a pretty random machine translation paper, and that's because I think the authors didn't fully anticipate the impact that the transformer would have on the field and this architecture that they produced in the context of machine translation in their case actually ended up taking over the rest of AI
